statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias
The service is to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period
The diagnoses are I49.9, I48.91, and R55
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the underlying cause of the recurrent symptoms
